user.title: Setup integration
user.description: With a key, the integration solves the login captcha itself and renews the token when it expires. Get one on [your Browserless API keys page]({api_keys_url}): the default key is enough. Your credentials never leave Home Assistant, since the remote service only mints the captcha. Browserless gives 1000 free units a month and a login usually costs no more than 14. Without a key, you have to paste the token by hand.

token.title: Provide user OAuth Token

data.token: OAuth Token (leave empty if you provide an API key)

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: Paste a fresh token to carry on by hand, or enter a browser service API key and the integration will get its own from now on, so this form stops coming back. Browserless gives you one on [your API keys page]({api_keys_url}): sign in, copy the default key, paste it here. Your credentials never leave Home Assistant, since the remote service only mints the captcha.
